name: agent-browser-benchmark
description: How five browser automation surfaces perform when a Claude Code agent drives them: 670 runs, raw transcripts included

scripts.selfcheck: node src/selfcheck.mjs --engine chromium && node src/selfcheck.mjs --engine webkit
scripts.bench: node src/runner.mjs --tasks all --variants all --repeats k0=3,k1=3,k2=5,k3=5 --out results/main --parallel --max-minutes 100
